whats.HSBC Flags Buying Opportunities in India: HSBC sees buying opportunities in Indian stocks even as global AI investment risks worry other investors.
whats.Can AI predict cancer survival from a se: A new study on predicting cancer survival from a selfie shows AI is moving into sensitive personal health territory.

term.def: This means AI spending and valuations rising faster than the real business value being created, which raises the risk of a sharp correction later.

prompt.prompt: List the AI related investments or tools our company has spent on this year, then flag which ones show measurable returns and which ones are still unproven for [team or department].

quiz.q: Siliconindia reports that HSBC flagged buying opportunities in Indian stocks as global AI investments face risks.
quiz.why: This is what the Siliconindia headline states about HSBC's view on Indian stocks.

quiz.q: Open Magazine reports that SpaceX's AI business overtook Starlink as revenue jumped 161 percent to 14.6 billion dollars.
quiz.why: This matches the figures and claim in the Open Magazine headline.

quiz.q: AI chatbots always give the exact same answer to the exact same question.
quiz.why: Generative AI tools can vary their wording or even their conclusions each time, even with identical input.

quiz.q: Only technology companies need to think seriously about AI strategy.
quiz.why: AI now touches hiring, finance, operations and customer service in almost every industry, not just tech firms.

quiz.q: AI tools can state wrong information very confidently, without signaling any doubt.
quiz.why: This is a well known limitation called hallucination, and managers should always verify important AI outputs.
